24.name: damage
24.summary: Deal Points damage (x(1+0.05*Power), type/state mods). Accuracy roll. IsPeriodic=DoT (not direct). OverrideIndex=follow-up hit of a volley.

26.name: aura_positive
26.summary: Apply aura to caster. Duration rounds (0=current round only, -1=infinite). Accuracy (200=cannot miss).

50.name: aura_negative
50.summary: Apply aura to target. ChainFailure skips if previous effect failed; MaxAllowed=stack cap (0 => treat as 1/refresh); CasterState=required caster state.

23.name: heal
23.summary: Heal Points (x(1+0.05*Power), healing mods 65/66). Variance=total spread % (+-V/2).

49.name: aura_remove
49.summary: Remove aura `aura` from holder with Chance% (0 and >=100 => always). Fires the aura's ev5 (ON_AURA_REMOVED).

54.name: aura_periodic
54.summary: Apply periodic/DoT or object aura to target (or pad). ChainFailure, Duration, MaxAllowed stack cap.

158.name: gate_stop_if_prev_missed
158.summary: Stop remaining effects of the turn if the previous effect missed/failed.

22.name: noop_data
22.summary: No-op placeholder turn / numeric data holder for tooltips (Points, MorePoints, EvenMorePoints).

116.name: recalc_stats
116.summary: Recalculate derived stats/turn order (max HP, speed) after state changes; one row per affected pet.

52.name: aura_control
52.summary: Apply control aura (stun/root/flee-lock) to target; Accuracy is the proc chance; ChainFailure.

177.name: gate_immune_if_state
177.summary: If target has State (149 resilient) the following effects fail as Immune.

85.name: remove_auras_with_state
85.summary: Remove all auras on target (pet/pad) that carry State X (e.g. 69 objects, 71 flat DR, 124 type override).

28.name: aura_caster_until_removed
28.summary: Apply aura to caster; Duration 0 = until explicitly removed/consumed (round-scoped dodge/priority auras, block-next-attack shields).

178.name: aura_unless_state
178.summary: Apply aura unless target.State[TargetState]==StatePoints (then Immune if ReportFailsAsImmune). Used for stun/sleep vs resilient.

80.name: set_weather
80.summary: Apply weather aura globally, replacing current weather; Duration; Accuracy 200.

29.name: damage_if_state
29.summary: Bonus damage only if caster has RequiredCasterState / target has RequiredTargetState.

384.name: damage_if_first
384.summary: Extra damage only if caster acted first this round.

141.name: damage_split_team
141.summary: Damage split evenly across living enemies; +BonusPoints if BonusState (weather) active.

27.name: damage_ramping
27.summary: Ramping damage: Points + PointsIncreasePerUse*uses, capped at PointsMax; resets when another ramping ability is used (states 26/27).

32.name: heal_pct_last_dealt
32.summary: Heal caster Points% of Last_HitDealt (state 32); ChainFailure.

135.name: instakill
135.summary: Kill self/aura holder unless CasterImmuneState/TargetImmuneState present; enableReverse=reversible death (Haunt).

145.name: swap_highest_health
145.summary: Swap to highest-health pet; side (forced enemy swap vs self swap) not encoded.

62.name: damage_pct_max_hp
62.summary: Damage = Points% of victim's max health (victim varies: target, self, attacker).

139.name: swap_lowest_health
139.summary: Swap to lowest-health pet; side not encoded.

136.name: dispel_all
136.summary: Remove all auras from target (wrapped in state 141 IsCleansing). Target side not encoded.

179.name: thorns
179.summary: On ev1 (damage taken): deal Points damage to the attacker.

104.name: heal_if_state
104.summary: Heal caster if caster/target required states are met (e.g. target dead = killed it).

159.name: reset_chain
159.summary: Unknown; between repeated team aura applies and after op194. Probably clears previous-effect result / advances target.

131.name: aura_if_first
131.summary: Apply aura (interrupt stun) only if caster acted before target this round.

107.name: swap_random
107.summary: Swap to a random pet; side not encoded.

150.name: team_shield_object
150.summary: Create a team-pad shield object aura that blocks N attacks.

68.name: damage_pct_caster_max_hp
68.summary: Damage = Points% of caster's max health (Explode).

156.name: gate_stop_if_state
156.summary: Stop remaining effects if target has State (non-zero).

76.name: two_stage_caster
76.summary: 1st use: apply aura on caster; 2nd use: consume it and deal Points damage.

96.name: damage_autohit_if_state
96.summary: Damage; skips hit roll (always hits) if caster has CasterState or target has TargetState.

229.name: aura_type_override
229.summary: Apply type-override aura (state 124), replacing existing one; target follows previous effect.

363.name: damage_pct_current_hp
363.summary: Damage = Points% of target's current health.

100.name: heal_if_pet_type
100.summary: Heal only if caster/target pet type matches (1-based type ids).

226.name: damage_bonus_if_state
226.summary: Damage + BonusPoints if target has BonusState.

246.name: cooldown_modify_slot
246.summary: Modify cooldown of ability slot Index by CooldownModification (0 = reset).

373.name: replace_ability_slot
373.summary: Temporarily replace ability in Slot with Ability.

112.name: resurrect_allies
112.summary: Resurrect other dead allies (RequiredTargetState=1) at Percentage% health.

63.name: aura_positive_periodic
63.summary: Apply positive periodic aura (heal-over-time, Wish) to caster/own pad.

169.name: damage_state_req
169.summary: Damage with caster/target state requirements; weather ticks (both heads) and on-damage procs.

172.name: aura_chance_or_state
172.summary: Apply aura with Accuracy% chance; guaranteed if caster has CasterState or target has TargetState.

385.name: damage_if_last
385.summary: Extra damage only if caster acted last this round.

59.name: damage_if_lower_hp
59.summary: Bonus damage if caster's health is lower than target's.

248.name: aura_positive_if_state
248.summary: Apply positive aura only if caster has RequiredCasterState.

138.name: modify_state_if_target_state
138.summary: Modify caster State by StateChange if target has TargetTestState(=Value).

111.name: resurrect_self
111.summary: Resurrect self at Percentage% health (Failsafe, Damned, Dark Rebirth).

223.name: aura_allies_of_type
223.summary: Apply aura to allies whose pet type == RequiredPetType (1-based).

128.name: set_health_pct
128.summary: Set health to Percentage% of max.

230.name: aura_haunt
230.summary: Apply aura to target with caster/target state exclusions (Haunt).

197.name: damage_pct_last_taken
197.summary: Damage = Power% of caster's last hit taken.

149.name: damage_nonlethal
149.summary: Damage that cannot reduce target below 1 HP.

194.name: gate_continue_if_prev_missed
194.summary: Continue only if previous effect missed.

254.name: heal_low_hp_bonus
254.summary: Heal; +Modifier% if caster health below Threshold%.

117.name: lock_ability_slot
117.summary: Lock ability slot Index for LockDuration rounds.

77.name: two_stage_target
77.summary: 1st use: apply aura on target (Duration); 2nd use: consume and deal Points damage.

204.name: reflect_damage
204.summary: On damage taken: deal Points% of the damage back to attacker.

137.name: aura_if_state
137.summary: Apply aura for Duration if caster has CasterState==CasterStateValue (or target TargetState).

45.name: damage_if_slower
45.summary: Damage +Boost% if caster slower than target.

97.name: damage_if_faster
97.summary: Damage +Boost% if caster faster than target.

86.name: damage_repeat_aura
86.summary: Damage; if target already has marker aura from previous use, apply AuraID for Duration2 (Gravity).

75.name: two_stage_caster_pad
75.summary: 1st use: aura on caster pad; 2nd use: consume and deal damage (Launch Rocket).

249.name: replace_ability_slot_alt
249.summary: Replace ability in Slot with Ability (variant of op373).

370.name: damage_per_same_species
370.summary: Damage + BonusDamage per additional ally of the same species.

140.name: refresh_aura_duration
140.summary: Set remaining duration of existing instances of `aura` to NewDuration.

256.name: unknown_aura_apply
256.summary: Only in DATA ERROR 615 (Accuracy, Duration=9, no aura).

67.name: equalize_health
67.summary: Equalize health between caster and target (gain capped at caster max).

165.name: revive_aura_caster
165.summary: On aura removal: revive the caster that died reversibly via op135 enableReverse (Haunt).

78.name: plant_toggle_heal
78.summary: Toggle planted aura; on deactivate heal Points x State counter (max MaxPoints).

129.name: lock_used_ability
129.summary: On ev9: put the ability just used by the holder on LockDuration cooldown.

65.name: damage_periodic_weather_bonus
65.summary: Periodic damage + BonusPoints if BonusState (weather) active.

171.name: heal_if_state
171.summary: Heal if caster/target required state present (e.g. Sunlight bonus).

144.name: select_corpse
144.summary: Select an unused dead ally corpse as target (Consume Corpse).

61.name: heal_pct_state_req
61.summary: Heal Points% of max health if required states met.

1.name: ON_DAMAGE_TAKEN
1.summary: Holder (or ability user this round) takes damage; thorns, break-on-damage, 'was struck' flags.

2.name: ON_DAMAGE_DEALT
2.summary: Holder deals damage; next-attack buffs consumed, lifesteal, Brittle Webbing.

3.name: ON_HEAL_TAKEN
3.summary: Name from Blizzard tooltip env; unused in data.

4.name: ON_HEAL_DEALT
4.summary: Name from Blizzard tooltip env; unused in data.

5.name: ON_AURA_REMOVED
5.summary: Aura expired/removed/consumed; bombs detonate, post-stun Resilient, Undead death.

6.name: ON_ROUND_START
6.summary: Before abilities resolve (priority/dodge auras, state resets).

7.name: ON_ROUND_END
7.summary: After both abilities, before aura ticks (undo priority, end-of-round swaps).

10.name: ON_SWAP_IN
10.summary: A pet enters the battlefield (Minefield, Mudslide, Bend Time).

12.name: ON_POST_AURA_TICK
12.summary: After aura processing phase (Feign Death/Warning!/Return to Rest swap). Not in Blizzard's PROC list; petsim 'postAuraTick'.
